purpose: Inventory real measured injection-moulding datasets and data-bearing studies without conflating public metadata, downloadable files, reuse rights, record units, or independent experimental evidence.

datasets.title: Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding
datasets.sampling: record-level; not high-frequency shot trace
datasets.statusNote: Completed benchmark; exact workbook fingerprint and 26-field normalized result retained without raw rows.

datasets.title: High-resolution injection-moulding time-series datasets (scatimdata)
datasets.sampling: 6 ms; 2049 points per time series
datasets.statusNote: Completed high-frequency benchmark; delivered files contain 2,048 stored values per signal despite the paper reporting 2,049, so accepted counts use the exact release.

datasets.title: Hot-runner molded sustainable-material experimental supplementary data
datasets.sampling: record-level DOE observations
datasets.statusNote: Completed exact-source supplement benchmark; delivered release has 955 rows and 45 substantive fields across five material groups, three more fields than the paper-reported 42.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels
datasets.sampling: combined per-cycle PARQUET features
datasets.statusNote: Publicly downloadable B2SHARE record; current authoritative Rights > License field is blank, so exact manifests are retained but automated raw ingestion remains blocked.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels (d-optimal Design of Experiment pattern)
datasets.sampling: combined per-cycle PARQUET features
datasets.statusNote: Publicly downloadable B2SHARE record; current authoritative Rights > License field is blank, so exact manifests are retained but automated raw ingestion remains blocked.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table)
datasets.sampling: time-resolved pressure plus machine records
datasets.statusNote: Exact seven-file publisher manifest and checksums are pinned, but the authoritative B2SHARE Rights > License field is blank; public download is not treated as permission for automated waveform ingestion.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Process Data for Post-Consumer-Recycled Materials
datasets.sampling: time-resolved; exact cycle count requires delivery of the advertised archive
datasets.statusNote: Reuse rights are confirmed CC BY 4.0, but same-repository source run 33229910280 received a 248-byte HTML response rather than ExperimentalData.zip on all tested URL variants; remains non-counting until the real archive is delivered and profiled.

datasets.title: ImPure Injection Molding Sensor Data - Trial 17th May
datasets.licenseEvidence: official Zenodo records API metadata.license.id = cc-by-4.0
datasets.sampling: 307 cycle CSVs plus two trial/stage files; one consistent nine-column cycle schema
datasets.statusNote: Completed hosted CC BY 4.0 profile: all 309 publisher files checksum-verified, 307 cycle files, 297,087 cycle rows, one cycle schema and no width mismatches. The 2,376,696 numeric values remain outside accepted time-series totals until source units and analogue-channel semantics are established.

datasets.title: Plastic road-lens injection-moulding quality dataset
datasets.license: Freely released for research and educational purposes; not a standard OSI/data licence
datasets.sampling: one process feature vector per lens; not high-frequency waveform data
datasets.statusNote: Exact pinned source is fully profiled for MouldMaster's educational scope: 1,451 rows x 13 complete process fields, with delivered quality counts 370/406/310/365. README class 4 count is short by five. Raw redistribution remains disallowed and the source contributes zero time-series samples.

datasets.title: OpenMMS-T4G real mould-monitoring case data
datasets.sampling: mould-side monitoring ordered time series with two source-defined time bases
datasets.statusNote: Completed exact-source benchmark: 29,808 ordered rows, 10 measured sensor channels, two strictly increasing time bases and 298,080 accepted measured values.

datasets.title: FORinFPRO-HIMD multimodal hybrid injection-moulding sensor dataset
datasets.licenseEvidence: official Zenodo records API metadata.license.id = cc-by-4.0
datasets.sampling: one synchronized delivered cycle; unit-limited values excluded from accepted time-series total
datasets.statusNote: Official Zenodo API confirms CC BY 4.0. Three files were retrieved and fingerprinted; the one-cycle schema is accepted, but channel values remain outside the time-series total where units are not explicit.

datasets.title: Cross-process-chain dataset archive: injection molding and screw driving
datasets.licenseEvidence: official Zenodo records API metadata.license.id = cc-by-4.0
signals: lower: injection pressure target (command, bar; excluded from measured total)
upper: pressure target/actual, melt volume, injection velocity, state (engineering units unresolved)
downstream screw-driving streams (excluded from injection-moulding counts)
datasets.sampling: lower: 4,989 source-conforming TXT files, each declaring 0.0300 s and matching observed time deltas (33.333... Hz); upper: 10,697 CSV cycle files remain structurally available but unit-limited; screw-driving streams excluded
datasets.statusNote: Exact CC BY 4.0 archive passed publisher MD5, local SHA-256 and ZIP CRC. A source-native lower-workpiece parser validated 4,989/4,989 TXT files, 2,475,581 rows and the exact units/labels/signal codes. Three actual channels contribute 7,426,743 accepted measured values; 2,475,581 pressure-target command values are retained but excluded. The family remains scope-limited because authoritative engineering units for the upper-workpiece CSV are not yet established.

datasets.title: KAMP injection-moulding factory dataset
datasets.sampling: record-level factory actuals
datasets.statusNote: The analysis repository says the data originated from KAMP, but its MIT code licence does not prove rights for the original manufacturing dataset; automated raw ingestion remains blocked pending authoritative KAMP terms.

datasets.title: Foxconn industrial injection-moulding competition dataset
datasets.sampling: cycle traces approximately 40–43 s plus scalar status/settings
datasets.statusNote: High-value 16,600-cycle competition source remains mirror-rights blocked: the original official download is no longer authoritative/available, and public mirrors do not establish redistribution or automated-ingestion rights.

datasets.title: High-speed demoulding/ejection experimental dataset
datasets.sampling: high-speed DAQ; exact trials/channels/samples require validated Origin project export
datasets.statusNote: All five CC BY 4.0 OPJU files are retrieved and SHA-256 verified. Remaining blocker is technical extraction: validated Windows Origin/OriginPro export is required before any trial, channel or sample count is accepted.

datasets.title: Preform injection molding analysis - Database
quality: simulated/predicted residual-stress outputs; no source-defined measured quality outcome
datasets.sampling: record-level database; not accepted as measured-quality evidence
datasets.statusNote: Exact workbook is retrieved and fingerprinted, but the 27-row schema mixes process inputs with simulated/predicted residual-stress outputs and has no source-defined measured quality outcome, so it remains review-only and non-counting.

datasets.title: Injection-Molded Polypropylene Parts: Experimental Process Dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 metadata; raw files embargoed
datasets.sampling: batch/configuration-level, not waveform
datasets.statusNote: CC BY 4.0 files remain embargoed until 2027-12-31 or earlier depositor release; metadata structure is retained but no raw retrieval or accepted count is claimed before live availability is rechecked.

datasets.title: Injection-molded plastic parts defect dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 metadata; raw files embargoed
datasets.recordUnit: injected part/image linked to parameter configuration
datasets.sampling: part/image-level defect evidence
datasets.statusNote: CC BY 4.0 image/label files remain embargoed until 2027-12-31 or earlier release. This shares the same 1,000-batch campaign as the companion process dataset and must not be double-counted as an independent injection experiment family.

datasets.title: Industry 4.0 In-Line AI Quality Control of Plastic Injection Molded Parts experimental data
datasets.sampling: multi-rate machine and in-mould sensor data
datasets.statusNote: Correct paper DOI is 10.3390/polym14173551. The paper reports ~2,500 samples across 56 DOE experiments but states that data are available upon request; raw files and authorised data-use terms are required before source profiling.

datasets.title: Industrial bottle-cap quality-deterioration production data
datasets.sampling: cycle-level production history
datasets.statusNote: Strong real-production evidence: the paper reports 7,162 cycles, but explicitly states the underlying data are confidential. Use as Tier-B literature evidence only unless an authorised site/data agreement is obtained.
